offers.offer: Web Hosting Launch: official SAVE 75% label
offers.conditions: The Yearly selection on the official hosting page marks Web Hosting Launch On Sale and displays SAVE 75%. Follow that plan's official Sign Up Now link. This is the provider's printed label, not a percentage calculated from the introductory and renewal prices by this site.

offers.offer: One free first-year domain registration credit
offers.conditions: For eligible new accounts with annual Web Hosting, annual DreamPress, or 1–3-year annual Managed VPS plans. One credit per account, for one qualifying extension listed in the official program (including .com, .net and .org). Use it within the first three months after signup. Monthly Web Hosting and monthly DreamPress are excluded.

offers.offer: Remixer: free for 30 days, no credit card
offers.conditions: The official Remixer website-builder page advertises a 30-day free trial without a credit card. This offer is specifically for Remixer; it does not establish free trials for every hosting product. Use the official Remixer page to start.

terms.offer: Web Hosting Launch first-year and renewal prices
terms.conditions: With Yearly selected, the official page lists $2.89/mo for the first year and automatic renewal at $10.99/mo after one year. The page states that the full term plus taxes is charged at checkout. These are the original USD price labels, not monthly-payment or tax-inclusive quotes.

The Terms say contracts renew for the original term length at the then-current non-promotional rate until cancelled. Cancel before the renewal date to avoid renewal. Review your account's current term and renewal details.

terms.offer: Hosting promotion calendar expiry: not published
terms.conditions: The Web Hosting Launch promotion checked did not publish a calendar end date. The first-year pricing period is not a campaign-expiry date. Missing information does not mean the promotion is permanent.

The free credit covers only the first registration year; later domain renewals use the regular renewal price. If you use the credit and close the hosting plan before its annual period is complete, the official program makes you responsible for the registration cost, usually deducted from a refund or due balance.

The Terms limit this guarantee to credit-card and PayPal payments for eligible Website Hosting Services. Email Service, Dedicated Server, VPS, Remixer and DreamCompute are excluded. Do not apply a general hosting-card guarantee to an excluded product. For applicable hosting cancelled after the guarantee period, the Terms do not refund unused portions.

The Terms say other payment methods are non-refundable. Domain registrations, including used registration credits, and SSL certificates are non-refundable; so are Remixer subscriptions and credits. The value of trial periods and third-party add-ons is not refundable.
